g.text: Twenty-seven disclosures, six of which are the floor

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: every one of the 27 disclosures the index holds, from 10 entities, and which of them the 300.1T/day floor

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: is actually made of. Six rows are in it. The other 21 are superseded, out of scope, or already inside a row that is.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Tokens Per Day (tokensperday.com) — evidence_ledger.csv — chartData objects and evidence ledger as extracted 2026-08-21

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows the Tokens Per Day published methodology and estimates pages

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Doubao's 180T/day is the largest number in the ledger and contributes nothing: it is inside China's national aggregate and adding it

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: would count it twice. Microsoft's floor row is its 2024-12-30 figure rather than its later one, because the later disclosure covers a

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: narrower product. 13 of 27 sources have an archived snapshot; the rest are live links only, and a live link is not evidence once it

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: changes. This is one publisher's index, not an industry return. The floor is what companies said; everything above it is triangulated

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: from revenue, hardware, users and telemetry by parties who do not have the numbers.
